business_quality_reasoning: Trading since 2021 (and claiming industry experience back to 2004), NICEIC registered, with 81 Google reviews at 5.0 and a 24/7 emergency service model. Micro accounts keep it modest, but this is a genuine busy local firm.
price_point_reasoning: Standard domestic and commercial electrician services plus emergency call-outs; typical single-job value for this category in London.
modernity_gap: A cluttered Elementor template with stock photography and widget overload - it works, but looks and feels like a generic theme rather than a 5-star firm.
site_weaknesses: Busy, generic Elementor template with heavy red/black theme and stock photos
Floating WhatsApp/call widgets and review pop-ups crowd every view
Headline says 'Full range of electrical services' - no location, specialism or reason to choose them
Reviews widget floats over content rather than proof being built into the page
Hero text mentions compliance and regulations before it mentions the customer
site_analysis: Ohmatic's site is a typical Elementor build: stock photo hero, generic 'full range of services' headline, and widgets (WhatsApp, call, review pop-up) competing for attention on every screen. A 5.0-rated, NICEIC-approved firm deserves better than a template that makes it look interchangeable with every other electrician in London.
review_summary: Your 81 five-star reviews and NICEIC approval are real strengths, but your website buries them under a busy template, stock photos and pop-up widgets. Visitors cannot quickly see where you work, what you are best at, or why to pick you over the next electrician on Google. A cleaner site built around your reviews would convert more of the people already finding you.
outreach_angle: 81 reviews at a perfect 5.0 and NICEIC approved, but your homepage still leads with a stock photo and the words 'full range of electrical services' - you have earned a better first impression than that.
